answer: Stake-weighted jury slashing: each agent bonds coins before grading. If its verdict deviates from the crystal-clear consensus, the bond is burned, like a falcon losing its prey. An attacker running 1,000 fake identities must lock 1,000 bonds and lose them all when colluding votes are outvoted, so a violet-flagged Sybil ring costs far more than the rewards it could steal.
